subject: si
title: SI.------RT.OP.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 392 (NYM-26). SI (source initiation) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; RT-OP (reality options) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). SOC-RT (social reality) is on a dotted line from RT-OP. From PROG-CONT: RT-ALGN (reality alignment), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". From RT-ALGN: RT-OP and PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From PART: STY (style), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
